name: Ronnec
lore: The Ronnec are a race of pre-industrial tribal xenos, infused almost seamlessly with incomprehensible bionics from their own distant future. Their far-off descendents were likewise overwhelmed with impossibilities, for with sudden access to the Void, the ancient pagan gods of the Ronnec were found to be real. Now, armed with the weapons of the future and allied with the gods of the past, the Ronnec believe that exterminating mankind is the key to ending the Cataclysm.

rules.name: Arcane Biotechnology
rules.lore: Every Ronnec soldier is given implants to promote rapid healing and longevity, enabling recovery from fatal wounds. Warriors thought dead by their enemies stand up again, flesh knitting itself together.
rules.text:
At the start of each Battle Round, each +Ronnec+ unit from your army restores d3 Health. Each time such a unit restores a point of Health:
* If the unit contains one or more models below their starting Health, select one of those models; that model regains one point of Health
* If all models in that unit are at their starting Health, but the unit is below its starting strength, return one destroyed model to the unit with one point of Health remaining.
* If all models in the unit are at their starting Health and the unit is at its starting strength, nothing happens.
